title: Stewed Pear with Sweet Australian Pear
description: A delicious Japanese-inspired dessert made with sweet Australian pears and stewed to perfection.
instructions: Wash and peel the Australian pears, and then cut them into large chunks.
In a saucepan, combine the pear juice, sugar, and water.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the pear chunks to the saucepan and continue to simmer for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the pears are tender.
Stir in the korean honey and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the stewed pears warm, garnished with a drizzle of korean honey if desired.
